title: FairVFL: A Fair Vertical Federated Learning Framework with Contrastive Adversarial Learning
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on a technical framework for achieving fairness in vertical federated learning, using gender and age as examples of sensitive attributes.
